statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℤ M) (c : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V), (∀ i, (b i : V) = c i) → Function.Injective (iota p M)
proof:
intro d b c hbc
have hs : Function.Injective (fun r : R p => r • (1 : ℂ)) := by
  change Function.Injective (fun r : R p => (algebraMap (R p) ℂ r) * (1 : ℂ))
  simp only [mul_one]
  change Function.Injective ((algebraMap ℚ ℂ).comp (localRing p).val.toRingHom)
  exact (algebraMap ℚ ℂ).injective.comp Subtype.val_injective
have hi : LinearIndependent (R p) (fun i => c i) :=
  LinearIndependent.restrict_scalars (R := R p) (K := ℂ) hs c.linearIndependent
apply LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent (b.baseChange (R p)).span_eq
have he : (iota p M) ∘ (b.baseChange (R p)) = fun i => c i := by
  funext i
  simp [Module.Basis.baseChange_apply, iota, hbc]
rw [he]
exact hi

@checked : ∀ {V : Type} [instVAdd : AddCommGroup V] [instVMod : _root_.Module ℂ V] (p : ℕ) (lam : ℤ) (K : Type)
  [instK : Field K] (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p →
    0 ≤ lam ∧ lam < ↑p →
      Module.Finite ℂ V ∧
          Module.finrank ℂ V = (lam + 1).toNat ∧
            h * x - x * h = 2 • x ∧ h * y - y * h = -2 • y ∧ x * y - y * x = h ∧ Highest lam x h ∧ Simple x y h →
        Admissible M x y →
          Coordinates lam x y h v →
            ∀ (d : ℕ) (b : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℤ ↥M) (c : Module.Basis (Fin d) ℂ V),
              (∀ (i : Fin d), ↑(b i) = c i) → Function.Injective ⇑(iota p M)
